reviews.x: At first the handle seems a bit fragile, but don't let that fool you.  These brushes are wonderful.  They do not shed and they are densly packed, delivering wonderfully even product.  These glide foundation into the skin effortlessly.  I love these brushes.  The eye ones take some getting used to if you are new to oval brushes, but after practice, they work well.  Some of the eye brushes pack on the pigment, so if trying to go a smokey eye look or a blended crease, use minimal product and a ligh

reviews.t: I like these. I give them 4 stars because they ...
reviews.x: I like these. I give them 4 stars because they are really nice, but have a few setbacks. I use the large one for foundation. The handle broke off after a few months, and it is very difficult to clean liquid foundation out of. I still use it, but it's not as nice and the brush part seems like it is coming loose. I am not a fan of using the smaller ones for eyeshadow though. Some people like them, but I like using just regular brushes. The large and medium sized ones are great for foundation, blus
Great product! Bristles are super soft and dense! The larger brushes are perfect for applying foundation.

Love these! I know they are a complete knock-off but I have to say I still feel they do a better job applying makeup than my beauty blender or any other brushes that I own. The handles do have some give to them but as long as I place my index finger over the back of the spoon I have no issue. They are very dense yet feel incredibly soft when applying product. I will be purchasing another set as a Christmas gift for my sister.

reviews.t: Awesome brush for an amazing price!
reviews.x: Absolutely amazing, ING product. Box was in perfect condition, and the brushes are SO soft! It made applying my foundation an absolute pleasure! Would definitely recommend to any girls who enjoy makeup! I was going to order a silicone blender, and after having these, I canceled my order.

I like the brushes because they were super soft, but the rose gold coloring was already peeling when I received it (not that big of a deal) but after using it for less than two weeks, the handle came apart. Cheap quality for cheap brushes, you get what you pay for.

These are so great!! I think they got enough complaint about not being boxed and getting broken in delivery because I received mine in a box, everything was accounted for and in tact! I love these. I'll be buying another set for a Christmas present!

reviews.t: So soft and easy to use
reviews.x: The brushes are incredible! So soft and easy to use.  A birthday gift for my daughter and she loves them!!
Ordered one for both of my daughters for Christmas not happy when one was an incomplete set..
These look great but broke the 2nd day of using them.  Totally disappointed

I wanted to try out these types of brushes but didn't want to spend too much. This was a great price for the set. However, they are not very sturdy. I've used all the rounder brushes in the set, small, medium and large. They are incredibly soft and blend out my foundation very well. Some of the brushes have come apart from the handles already but what can you expect for the price. I'm more inclined to keep using the larger brushes from the set as I can find much use for the smallest and thin one

I received these a few days ago and I already love them so much. I use them for everything except for my eyes. It makes a little product go a long way but along with that, it applies it so beautifully. I prefer these with harder foundations (sticks or creams) and a beauty blender for liquids, BUT this works perfectly with liquids, that's just a personal preference. They all are so pretty and useful. I highly recommend. Great quality for a great price. Amazing dupe for the Artis Brushes.

Pretty dang good quality for the price. I noticed a tiny tiny amount of shedding pretty quickly but it wasn't even really shedding, just a few of the hairs sticking out further than the rest. DON'T BEND THEM THOUGH. I was a total moron and remembered seeing some pictures showing how flexible these brushes were. These ones don't bend! I snapped one of brushes without thinking :| Other than that I really really love them. Great for quickly applying a base and contouring.

I had to return these because the largest brush was broken. That aside, I was not the biggest fan of the handle of these brushes. These do not have any flexibility and the bristles are not as densely packed as others I have worked with. The rubberized handle also had a little bit of an order but I think that was just my pack -gotta love the Florida humidity. Perhaps as a starter set, because the price is nothing to sneeze at, these would be okay.

reviews.t: Handles flimsy but brush heads so soft and easy to ise
reviews.x: First thing I noticed was how soft the brush heads are. Just so amazing. My makeup applies so nicely with these brushes. Used them for concealer, powder, contour (cream and powder), eyeshadow. A little tricky with eyeshadow but I've only used them about 3 times so learning. The handles are flimsy like many reviews say. Mine haven't broken but to me unless I try I don't think they will. For $15 I think it's a great buy.

reviews.t: If you do not clean your brushes often.. these are not for you.
reviews.x: These brushes were excellent but if you are someone like me who does not keep up on cleaning their makeup brushes than these are not for you. If you do not clean them they were become permanently clumpy unless you have a powerful way of cleaning brushes lol They were great I loved how the face brushes applied but I would not recommend the rest of the small brushes as they are very inconvenient.

reviews.t: ... scared me but the quality of the brushes are good. They are
reviews.x: Reading reviews scared me but the quality of the brushes are good. They are, as other reviews say not rose gold but orange and are plastic but with my use they are not too fragile. They are worth it for the price just don't act like you are mixing cement and you should be fine.

These are pretty good brushes, and a great deal at the price offered. Very thick, dense heads make blending a dream! Just don't apply much pressure when using - I have had 2 of the larger brushes snap in half with minimal pressure as I was applying foundation and powder.

I use these primarily for blending foundation, contouring and blush. I use them in conjunction with straight brushes. They are very soft, yet firm enough for application and blending. I would definitely recommend them. They wash easily and do not fall apart. Must have!

I purchased several at Nordstrom's at a very high price!  i purchased these, figured if they didn't work, I didn't waste a great deal of money. They work great!  I love them. Putting on makeup, eyeshadow is so much easier now. I would highly recommend these brushes.

I started using these and now everyone is telling me how pretty my skin looks! I've changed nothing else but started using these for my foundation, eye shadow, powder and blush. They are super soft and make it so easy to apply liquid foundation. Great purchase.

reviews.t: Blend well and have held up for months
reviews.x: These brushes have held up very well. I've ended up only using two consistently, the long thin one for highlighter and one of the oval ones for contour. I still prefer a beauty blender to these for foundation but for more specific brushes they're great

Perfectly soft and fits perfect inside the stand I bought for them. The handles feel durable when I am using them since I use a lot of pressure. I love the color too. Fits with the other brushes I have and the décor of the vanity I put together myself.

These brushes are a tad flimsy but not too bad. They seem to work best for contouring, highlighting and foundation applications. They arent very good for eye shadow eye liner etc I do use most of them regularly and I am glad they didnt cost a fortune

reviews.t: THese are a great price and really pretty
reviews.x: THese are a great price and really pretty. The foundation brush works amazing!  The smaller brushes I really don't use. I believe a couple of the small ones came with the bristles messed up.  But the bigger ones make it worth the purchase.

claims.text: Reviewers frequently praise the brushes as very soft and densely packed, applying foundation smoothly and evenly.
A common complaint is that the handles are flimsy or break, sometimes within days or a few months of use.
Many reviewers consider the set a great value for the price.
Some reviewers report receiving broken or incomplete sets.
A few reviewers mention minor shedding or bristle issues.
